name: web-frosted-glass-banking-dashboard-on-monitor-with-layered-cards
title: Frosted Glass Banking Dashboard on Monitor
whatItIs: A tall monitor on a grey studio ground showing a frosted banking dashboard where pearlescent credit cards fan out above KPI strips, income bar chart, spending arc, monthly wave chart and a transactions list, with a tile sidebar.
whatItMeans: Pearl and frost tones feel luxurious and calm, and fanned cards make the cards the visual centre.
techniques: Pearlescent cards fanned at the top of the dashboard
Vertical bar chart with one dark and one red bar
Monitor on a dark tabletop against grey

vocabulary.definition: A soft iridescent sheen like a pearl.
A navigation sidebar built of square tiles.
